plan: Trim SPY to 20% to meet concentration limits and reduce broad index exposure.
Add QQQI to 20% for increased income and stability.
Sell QQQ, SMH, CRWD, METU, SNOW, MSFU, PLTU, SMCI, MUU as they are flagged for exit or below stop.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero for capital preservation.
This plan aims for capital preservation and a steady, low-drawdown approach.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5% monthly return, prioritizing capital preservation. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also limited upside potential. The focus is on stability and income.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Add QQQI to 15% to blend income with growth.
Sell QQQ, SMH, SNOW, METU, PLTU, SMCI, MUU as they are flagged for exit or below stop.
Trim CRWD to 5% to take some profit and reduce concentration.
Trim MSFU to 2% to reduce leveraged tech exposure.
Sell SOXL and SPAL to reduce leveraged ETF exposure to small.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% monthly growth with a risk-first approach. It aims for a blend of broad index, quality tech, and limited leverage. Expect moderate drawdowns and growth potential.

moves.note: Below stop, but reallocate to higher…

plan: Trim SPY to 20% and QQQI to 5% to free up capital for higher growth.
Sell QQQ, SMH, METU, SNOW, SOXL, PLTU, SMCI, SPAL, MUU as they are flagged for exit or below stop.
Add CRWD to 10% to press a winning position.
Add MSFU to 5% to increase leveraged tech exposure, despite being below stop, as part of a broader re-allocation to higher conviction.
Buy NVDD at 5% as a new, high-scoring scanner setup.
This plan leans into leverage and concentration for aggressive growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly growth, accepting significantly higher risk and potential drawdowns. Leverage amplifies both gains and losses, and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage risk.

plan: Trim SPY to 20% to meet concentration limits and free capital.
Add QQQI to 40% to maximize income and stability.
Sell QQQ, SMH, CRWD, METU, SNOW, MSFU, PLTU, SMCI, MUU as they are flagged for exit or below stop.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to near zero.
This plan prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1% monthly distributions, prioritizing low drawdown and reliable income. Distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff. This is for cash-like income, not a savings account.
